reject_at.header: parsing the fixed header fails (bad magic, version, lengths or chunk size)
reject_at.kdf: the KDF id or settings are unknown, malformed or over a cap; no KDF work is done
reject_at.key: the file key fails to unwrap (wrong secret, or the key block was modified)
reject_at.body: a chunk fails authentication, or data is missing, reordered or left over

vectors.name: argon2id-passphrase
vectors.description: Argon2id passphrase, 1 KiB chunks, three chunks (the last one partial).

vectors.name: argon2id-empty
vectors.description: Empty plaintext: a single empty final chunk (just a 16-byte tag).

vectors.name: argon2id-nfc
vectors.description: Accented passphrase, keyed with its NFC UTF-8 bytes as filecrypt does now. Opens whether the passphrase is entered composed (NFC) or decomposed (NFD).

vectors.name: argon2id-legacy-nfd
vectors.description: Accented passphrase keyed with its exact decomposed (NFD) bytes, as releases before passphrase normalization wrote. A decryptor must retry with the exact bytes when the NFC form fails.

vectors.name: scrypt-passphrase
vectors.description: scrypt passphrase, 1 KiB chunks, plaintext an exact multiple of the chunk size: three full chunks, the third flagged last, and no empty chunk after it.

vectors.name: hkdf-key
vectors.description: HKDF-SHA256 with a 32-byte key, 1 KiB chunks, three chunks.

vectors.name: hkdf-full-final
vectors.description: HKDF, two full 1 KiB chunks; the second is the final one.

vectors.name: hkdf-empty
vectors.description: HKDF, empty plaintext.

vectors.name: hkdf-default-chunk
vectors.description: HKDF with the default 64 KiB chunk size: one full chunk and a 100-byte final chunk.

vectors.name: bad-empty-file
vectors.description: Zero-length file.

vectors.name: bad-truncated-header
vectors.description: Cut off in the middle of the header.

vectors.name: bad-magic
vectors.description: Magic is not "FCX1".

vectors.name: bad-version
vectors.description: Version byte 2 (only 1 exists).

vectors.name: bad-settings-len
vectors.description: settings_len 1025, above the 1024-byte cap.

vectors.name: bad-chunk-size-1023
vectors.description: chunk_size 1023, below the 1 KiB minimum.

vectors.name: bad-chunk-size-16777217
vectors.description: chunk_size 16777217, above the 16 MiB maximum.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-unknown-kdf
vectors.description: Unknown KDF id 4. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-hkdf-settings
vectors.description: HKDF with a non-empty settings field. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-argon2id-settings-len
vectors.description: Argon2id settings of 8 bytes instead of 9. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-argon2id-memory
vectors.description: Argon2id memory 4 GiB + 1 KiB, above the 4 GiB cap. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-argon2id-iterations
vectors.description: Argon2id iterations 17, above the cap of 16. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-argon2id-lanes
vectors.description: Argon2id parallelism 17, above the cap of 16. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-argon2id-zero-lanes
vectors.description: Argon2id parallelism 0. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-argon2id-total-work
vectors.description: Argon2id 2 GiB x 9 iterations = 18 GiB of work, above the 16 GiB cap. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-scrypt-settings-len
vectors.description: scrypt settings of 10 bytes instead of 9. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-scrypt-log2n
vectors.description: scrypt log2(N) 23, above the cap of 22. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-scrypt-r
vectors.description: scrypt r 33, above the cap of 32. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-scrypt-p
vectors.description: scrypt p 17, above the cap of 16. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-scrypt-total-work
vectors.description: scrypt 4 GiB x p=5 = 20 GiB of work, above the 16 GiB cap. Must be refused without running the KDF.

vectors.name: bad-wrong-key
vectors.description: A valid file opened with the wrong key.

vectors.name: bad-salt-bit
vectors.description: One bit of the salt flipped.

vectors.name: bad-wrapped-key-bit
vectors.description: One bit of the wrapped file key's tag flipped.

vectors.name: bad-kdf-id-swapped
vectors.description: KDF id and settings rewritten to scrypt: the key block AAD no longer matches.

vectors.name: bad-argon2id-settings-changed
vectors.description: Argon2id iterations changed from 2 to 3 (still within the caps): the derived key and the key block AAD both change, so the right passphrase is rejected.

vectors.name: bad-passphrase
vectors.description: A valid file opened with the wrong passphrase.

vectors.name: bad-nonce-prefix-bit
vectors.description: One bit of the nonce prefix flipped (it is in every chunk's AAD and nonce).

vectors.name: bad-chunk-size-changed
vectors.description: chunk_size changed from 1024 to 2048 (still valid): it is in the chunk AAD.

vectors.name: bad-ciphertext-bit
vectors.description: One bit of chunk 1's ciphertext flipped.

vectors.name: bad-tag-bit
vectors.description: One bit of the final chunk's tag flipped.

vectors.name: bad-truncated-at-chunk-boundary
vectors.description: Final chunk removed: chunk 1 is now last but carries the not-last flag.

vectors.name: bad-truncated-mid-chunk
vectors.description: Last 100 bytes cut off.

vectors.name: bad-no-chunks
vectors.description: Header only: even an empty plaintext has one chunk.

vectors.name: bad-reordered-chunks
vectors.description: Chunks 0 and 1 swapped.

vectors.name: bad-trailing-byte
vectors.description: One byte appended after a full-size final chunk.

vectors.name: bad-trailing-chunk
vectors.description: The final chunk duplicated after itself.

vectors.name: bad-trailing-after-partial
vectors.description: 16 bytes appended after a partial final chunk.

vectors.name: bad-dropped-first-chunk
vectors.description: Chunk 0 removed: the counters no longer line up.
